caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a person with brown skin and long, dark hair, wearing a feathered headdress with a prominent brown feather standing upright at the top, and a band decorated with red beads across the forehead. The figure holds two large, dark feathers vertically in both hands at the center of the composition. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
